text.p: Borussia Dortmund swept aside Steaua Bucharest with a crushing 3-0 away win on Wednesday to maintain their 100 per cent record in Group B of the Champions' League.

First half goals from Lars Ricken and Joerg Heinrich and a third 13 minutes from the end by Swiss striker Stephane Chapuisat helped the German champions to an easy win in a match they totally dominated.
Ricken, scorer of the only goal in last season's two Champions' League fixtures between the two sides, struck in a swift counter-attack only seven minutes into the game.
Playmaker Andreas Moeller launched a long ball for the young German striker who ran into the box before netting with a shot just inside Romanian keeper Daniel Gherasim's right-hand post.
Borussia went further ahead in the 37th minute when Gherasim parried a Borussia shot which rebounded off German midfielder Joerg Heinrich into the net.
An inexperienced Steaua team, crushed 4-0 by Atletico Madrid two weeks ago, were only in the match early on but squandered two goalscoring chances.
Chapuissat scored Borussia's third goal one minute after coming on as substitute for Ricken.
Steaua midfielder Damian Militaru missing a great chance near the end of the match when he rattled the bar with a shot from just four metres out.
